description: Use this when the user asks what a domain extension is, what it means, who runs it, who can register it, or whether it fits their project ("is .ai good for a startup", "what is .io", "does .web exist"). Returns tld.expert’s editorial verdict, pros and cons, registry, registration restrictions, the use cases it ranks for, a typical price, and for "is .xyz safe / spammy" its phishing, spam and malware rates per 10,000 domains against .com's (Interisle's quarterly reports, sourced), for a gTLD the renewal-price protections of its ICANN registry agreement (section 2.10: 180 days' notice, uniform renewals), and how many domains the ending has ("how many .io domains"), dated and sourced. Also answers for well-known non-existent TLDs like .eth or .web.

tld.description: A TLD without or with the dot, e.g. "ai" or ".io"
